name: cover-tips
description: Two-stage selector that confirms a cover style and asset scope before routing to an installed cover skill.

interface.shortDescription: Confirm style and asset scope, then route to the matching cover skill
interface.longDescription: Two-stage CoverTips selector: first confirm a published cover style, then choose a single cover or an article cover-plus-inline package. Single covers route to the matching cover-X skill; article packages route only to the four with-docs siblings, including cover-cream-orange-knowledge-poster-with-docs. When style is missing, propose 1-3 candidates and wait for confirmation.
